{{Quote|Rowi's memory is still cherished by our people. He knew every herb in the mountains. He passed on his potions to Elan.|Domi|<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" />}}
'''Rowi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] healer who was one of the [[hill people]], the exiled residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]] who opposed the [[Galacian]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. He was the adoptive [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], who was the [[Reproduction/Legends|biological]] daughter of fellow hill person [[Tema]] and her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Cana]] of the [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]]. Highly skilled at healing, Rowi was regarded by the hill person elder [[Domi]] to have healing hands. He knew every [[Plant/Legends|herb]] in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of Gala and taught his potions to Elan. He [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" /> by [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> and his memory was cherished by his people.<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" />

When Elan learned of her heritage as the daughter of the former King of Gala and reclaimed her position as [[Princess/Legends|Princess]], she was urged to take on her biological family's name. Cana's second wife, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]], expected that she would take the Tallah name, but add it to Rowi and Tema's name.<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rowi was first mentioned in the [[1999]] novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]'' by [[Jude Watson]], the fourth installment of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] junior novel series.<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" />
